tasks.short: Supplement presentations with computers and audiovisual aids

steps.what: Read the teacher's presentation guidance and select the actual supplementary media
Arrange and check the selected media sequence in the presentation application
Check the actual audiovisual equipment and pupil accessibility
Use computers, audiovisual aids and equipment to supplement the actual presentation

tasks.design: Test native saved media sequences in the presentation application in {OTHER}. Reuse the known selection order only, retaining teacher-guidance reading, media checks, actual device setup and live use of the aids.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated media ordering accompanies substantive access and presentation checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Native media sequences can reuse known file references and order.
tasks.still_hard: Ensuring media and equipment suit the actual pupils and lesson.
tasks.human_edge: Notice accessibility problems and respond during the presentation.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated media ordering with unchanged classroom support duties.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: presentation applications can reuse ordered media references, while content suitability and equipment access need human checks.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a presentation with repeated media ordering. OTHER is the audiovisual presentation application. A one-off presentation without a reusable sequence has no new ordering benefit.

The teacher supplies existing lesson guidance and media; the assistant verifies file versions, intended order and access needs in s1-s2. Selection, missing-file repair and content checks remain counted. No free new media authoring is assumed.

Native sequences are assessed first. Only 3 of 25 manual reference/order-entry points are removed; 22 retain arrangement changes, checks, failed links and ordinary save. Existing automatic playback runtime earns no credit.
No pupil-progress log or recording is introduced. Ordinary author saves are ungated. A real separate upload or outward send would need its own counted gated step.
unknowns: Actual repeated sequence entry and application support
research_questions: Reuse one actual media sequence and count broken links, access checks and retained arrangement work.

incremental.description: Maintain saved media references and check changed file versions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 3 repeated media-order points less 0.5 upkeep. New file formats require fresh arrangement and checking; reuse only 1 point of ordinary sequence references: 1 minus 0.5 = 0.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare lesson materials, displays, equipment and demonstrations

steps.what: Read the teacher's lesson brief and verify pupil access and material requirements
Develop the assigned lesson content, display elements and demonstration instructions
Arrange repeated worksheet, display-label and reference fields from supplied content
Prepare physical bulletin displays, exhibits, equipment and demonstration arrangements
outputs: prepared lesson materials and demonstration setup

steps.what: Check the complete prepared materials, pupil suitability and demonstration safety
inputs: prepared lesson materials and demonstration setup

tasks.design: Configure native worksheet and display styles in {DOCS} before custom generation. Remove repeated layout only; retain the assistant's content preparation and physical setup and the classroom teacher's full check of the final materials.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated worksheet and display formatting accompanies content and physical preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native layouts can populate supplied labels, text and reference fields.
tasks.still_hard: Preparing accessible materials and safe demonstrations for individual pupils.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise practical support needs and check the actual classroom setup.
tasks.altitude: Less layout repetition with unchanged teacher-directed preparation duties.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates can arrange supplied lesson and display content; substantive preparation, physical assembly and teacher checks remain necessary.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for actual material preparation; focal assistant baseline is 90 points and existing teacher checking is 10 other-role points excluded from the assistant denominator. No teacher work is transferred or credited.

The assistant verifies brief version, content, labels, source references and pupil access needs in s1-s2. Fresh content, missing assets and source extraction remain counted. Native layouts are tested first.

Only 15 repeated layout points are removed. s2/s4 retain manual layout exceptions, physical repair and ordinary author saves; greater correction effort requires a lower estimate. Existing rendering runtime earns no credit.

Materials and displays are the task's actual outputs, not a new activity log. Teacher checking comes after the final preparation. No formal publication, print-job send or message is assumed; add each actual action separately if present. Ordinary author saves are ungated.
unknowns: Actual repeated layout share and teacher-check boundary
research_questions: Prepare one real material pack and display, counting missing assets, physical work and teacher corrections.

incremental.description: Maintain material styles and accessibility examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 15 of 90 assistant points = 16.67%, less 1.2 upkeep = 15.47%. For a bespoke tactile exhibit reuse only 3 points of ordinary labels and worksheet headings: 3/90*100 minus 1.2 = 2.13%; teacher and physical work stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Grade homework and tests and record results

steps.what: Verify homework or test responses and the teacher's exact answer key
Mark closed responses against the teacher's exact answer key
Grade open work and ambiguous responses under the teacher's instructions
Compute totals using the teacher's specified weights and rounding rules
Record original results and check pupil identity and completeness
Review final marks, totals and exact pupil visibility before result release
Release only the teacher-approved result snapshot to the specified pupil accounts

tasks.design: Configure native closed-answer marking and score totals in {LMS} before adding code. Retain open marking, original result recording and the classroom teacher's complete final review; pupil-visible release remains a separate small gated action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated key matching and arithmetic accompany marking judgement and original records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exact-answer rules can mark closed items and calculate specified totals.
tasks.still_hard: Handling ambiguous work, accommodations and the meaning of a pupil's answer.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise exceptions and keep the responsible teacher in control of outcomes.
tasks.altitude: Less exact-answer matching and arithmetic with unchanged teacher oversight.

evidence.claim: The supplied digest describes Ans closed-question grading and item analysis; it supports native exact-answer marking, not a local saving estimate.

assumptions: Provisional workflow includes actual marking, recording and pupil result release. Focal assistant baseline is 91 points; 9 teacher-review points remain other-role work excluded from its savings. If results are not released here, omit s7 and reweight without inventing a send.

The teacher supplies the existing key, weights, rounding and accommodations. The assistant verifies pupil ID, response/item ID and key version in s1, retaining response capture, extraction and unsupported-format repair. No free new scanning or key production is assumed.

Native marking and totals are tested first. Remove only 30 repeated exact-answer comparisons and 10 manual total-entry/arithmetic points. Existing automatic marking or calculator runtime earns no credit. Open work and all original record entry/save remain fully retained; repair beyond retained s1/s3/s5 requires lower savings.

s6 teacher review binds the exact final results and pupil visibility after the results exist. Any change voids it. s7 is actual pupil-visible release and keeps its full small time; ordinary author saves in s5 are ungated and earn no saving.
unknowns: Closed/open work mix and existing marking configuration
Actual pupil release and teacher-review duty
research_questions: Re-mark a real assignment using the same key and count capture, exceptions, teacher checks and release handling.

incremental.description: Maintain answer-key mappings and scoring-rule regression tests

approvals.approved_version: s6 exact final marks, totals and pupil-visible recipients; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 40 of 91 assistant points = 43.96%, less 1.5 upkeep = 42.46%. An open-work-heavy assignment leaves only 6 points of closed matching and 2 of reusable total arithmetic: 8/91*100 minus 1.5 = 7.29%; open marking and teacher checks stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assist pupils boarding and leaving buses

steps.what: Check actual pupil boarding arrangements and individual assistance requirements
Assist actual pupils safely during bus loading and unloading

tasks.design: Retain actual boarding assistance and separate reading of pupil needs in {DOCS}. Native arrangement access already supplies context; the assistant still provides the physical help and live safety checks.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe boarding depends on the actual pupil and vehicle situation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing arrangements support preparation without replacing physical assistance.
tasks.still_hard: Supporting pupils safely while monitoring changing boarding conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Provide immediate physical help and recognise individual access needs.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bus boarding assistance for pupils with disabilities requires physical help and live checks; a new boarding log is not inherent to the assistance task.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is one arranged boarding period. Transport organizers supply arrangements as existing work; assistant reading and live pupil checks remain counted.

Before zero, inspect roster lookup, handover records, attendance scans, incident reports and sends. This routine period has direct arrangements and establishes no separate written duty. Add any actual required boarding record or incident report before estimating that broader workflow.
Native document access comes first and already direct. No new boarding log or automatic surveillance is introduced; no implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual transport handover or record-entry requirements
research_questions: Observe bus assistance and identify any real roster entry or handover message beyond live safety checks.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 10 arrangement-reading and 90 boarding-assistance points. A pupil with unfamiliar support needs still requires full preparation and physical help; no established duplicate record or send is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain accessible classroom support and teacher oversight while reducing verified media ordering, material layout and exact marking operations.
role.ambitious_version: No independent teacher authority or automated open-answer judgement is proposed.
